{{Top}}
{{Youmay|droid starfighters in general|the [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture starfighter]], commonly known simply as a droid starfighter}}
{{Quote|The combat programs for the droid starfighters are the very best.|[[Siv Kav]] to [[Kinman Doriana/Legends|Kinman Doriana]]|<ref name="Outbound Flight (novel)">[[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']]</ref>}}
[[File:Droid_Starfighters.png|250px|thumb|[[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|''Vulture''-class droid starfighters]]]]
A '''droid starfighter''' was any [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] powered by a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Droid brain/Legends|brain]]. They saw extensive use prior to and during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], particularly by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] would eventually create droid starfighters of its own.
